confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and comparables; no live price checks. Beer, restaurant, and dorm anchors are the most reliable; hotels are least certain given July demand swings. Cocktail (about 2.8x beer) and wine glass (about 1.4x beer) use local beer-relative ratios, so they are lower confidence. FX: 0.6961 (13 Oct 2026, 4pm) comes from a search-result summary of the RBA overview page, not a direct page read. A follow-up search did not reconfirm it, and no 14 Oct observation was found. Third-party quotes of 0.6979 (9-12 Oct) and 0.6956 (13 Oct) are consistent with it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Calibrated against Porto and Athens. Beer and mid-range meal are near Porto, cappuccino is slightly above Porto, and the inexpensive meal, hostel, and hotel anchors are below Porto and Athens, consistent with Bucharest's lower overall price level. Amsterdam was used only as a ceiling. Cocktail and wine anchors use beer-relative ratios.
